title: To Evaluate the Feasibility, Preliminary Safety and Performance of Rezūm System in BPH Treatment in China
brief_summary: A real world study to evaluate the feasibility, preliminary safety and performance of Rezūm system in BPH treatment in China Rezūm RWS study
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* The subjects will provide written informed consent form and agree to data collection.
* The subjects who were diagnosed as BPH and treated by Rezūm procedure in Hainan medical pilot zone will be enrolled in this study.

Exclusion Criteria:

* This is a retrospective study without any formal exclusion criteria.
study_population: Up to 30 subjects who were diagnosed as BPH and treated with Rezūm system will be collected to get 22 treated subjects with valid data.
